extracted.intended_audience: senior/key personnel and other significant contributors preparing NIH-style biographical sketches for grant applications
extracted.subtask_description: Preparing the NIH-format biographical sketch for senior/key personnel and other significant contributors on grant applications, following the specified sections and page limits. Includes Personal Statement, Education/Training, Positions and Honors, Contributions to Science, and Research Support.

rubrics_metrics.name: Biosketch format and page limit
rubrics_metrics.description: Provide the following information for the Senior/key personnel and other significant contributors. Follow this format for each person. DO NOT EXCEED FIVE PAGES.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Follow the specified format for each person; the entire biographical sketch must not exceed five pages. (This header/instruction appears at top of the form.)

rubrics_metrics.name: Identification fields (Name, eRA Commons user name, Position Title)
rubrics_metrics.description: NAME; eRA COMMONS USER NAME (credential, e.g., agency login); POSITION TITLE.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Include these required identification items at the top of the biosketch exactly as labeled.

rubrics_metrics.name: Education/Training
rubrics_metrics.description: EDUCATION/TRAINING (Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education, such as nursing, include postdoctoral training and residency training if applicable. Add/delete rows as necessary.)
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide institution and location, degree (if applicable), completion date (MM/YYYY), and field of study for each entry. Begin with baccalaureate or other initial professional education and include postdoctoral/residency training where applicable. Add or delete rows as necessary to fit the person's training history.

rubrics_metrics.name: A. Personal Statement
rubrics_metrics.description: Personal Statement (narrative summarizing the individual's expertise, relevance to the proposed project, and commitment).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Explain how the individual's content and methodological expertise position them for participation in the proposed project, cite relevant prior work and leadership positions, and state commitment to execution and completion. Example text demonstrates describing specific experience, prior leadership roles, and relevance to the project, and citing representative publications.

rubrics_metrics.name: B. Positions and Honors
rubrics_metrics.description: Positions and Honors (chronological listing of academic/professional positions and honors/awards).
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List positions with dates and institutional affiliation, and list honors and selected awards with years. Use a clear chronological format as shown in the examples.

rubrics_metrics.name: C. Contributions to Science
rubrics_metrics.description: Contributions to Science: numbered narrative descriptions of major research contributions, each supported by representative publications.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each major contribution provide a brief narrative describing the contribution and its significance, followed by representative citations (examples in the document are labeled a., b., c., d. and include journal, year, and identifiers such as PMID/PMCID/DOI). Use this structure for multiple contributions to convey impact and representative work.

rubrics_metrics.name: Complete list of published work (bibliography link)
rubrics_metrics.description: Complete List of Published Work in My Bibliography: [URL].
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Provide a link to the full bibliography (e.g., My NCBI bibliography) so reviewers can access the complete publication record; include sorting/direction if shown.

rubrics_metrics.name: D. Additional Information: Research Support and/or Scholastic Performance — Ongoing Research Support
rubrics_metrics.description: Ongoing Research Support entries listing grant number, funding agency, project title, role, period, and a brief project summary.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: For each ongoing grant provide the grant number (e.g., CBET-1548502), sponsoring agency (e.g., NSF, NIH institute), project title, role (e.g., Principal Investigator, Co-PI, Site PI), project period (start and end dates), brief description of the aims or responsibilities, and collaborators/PI where applicable. Format examples are provided in the document.

rubrics_metrics.name: Recently completed research support (formerly funded projects)
rubrics_metrics.description: Recently Completed (or Other) Research Support entries with grant number, agency, project title, role, dates, and brief description.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: List recent or completed grants similarly to ongoing support, including role and project summary. Use distinct sections for 'Ongoing' versus 'Recently Completed' support as shown in the example.
